design_philosophy.concept: Modern fintech, enterprise-credible, confident, clean. Built to maximize checkout conversion while establishing absolute trust with D2C brands in India.
key_traits: No cheesy badges or 'shiny text' chips
Generous whitespace using E1's 2-3x padding strategy
Subtle, tasteful motion utilizing only Magic UI components
Grid-based bento layouts for dense information presentation

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 md:px-12

sections.instructions: Sticky top-0 z-50 with backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70. Border bottom light/dark. Add Scroll Progress bar at the top edge. Include Logo (text 'RabbitPay'), Anchor nav links (Product, Pricing, Integrations, Support), and CTA Button (mailto). Dark mode toggle icon.

Large Aurora Text for '1-Click Checkout, built in India'. Clean sub-headline text-lg max-w-2xl text-muted. Primary CTA is a Shimmer Button (mailto). An iPhone mockup (CSS frame) showing a minimal RabbitPay checkout UI snippet. The background should be Retro Grid or Dot Pattern. Below the hero fold, include a stats strip using Number Ticker (e.g. '+<NumberTicker value={30} />% Conversion Rate').

Marquee sliding horizontally. Use clean typographic logos (font-bold text-xl to text-2xl tracking-tight text-ink/40 dark:text-dark_ink/40) for: 'Qwerty Cases', 'Rabbit Rain', 'Perlex', 'Airy Store', and 2-3 other generic D2C names. Monochromatic to avoid clashing.

Headline: 'Why RabbitPay'. Grid of 3-4 Magic Cards. Card 1 (col-span-2) features Border Beam around it and an Animated List of order events (Order placed -> OTP verified -> Shipped) simulating high velocity. Other cards highlight reduced RTO and faster load times.

Visual representation of data flowing from 'Shopify Store' to 'RabbitPay Checkout' to 'Customer Bank' back to 'Order Confirmed'. Use Animated Beam to connect these nodes. Generous padding around the nodes.

Alternating rows. Row 1: Left text about RTO reduction, Right visual uses Animated Circular Progress Bar showing e.g. 45% reduction. Row 2: Right text about Pan-India reach, Left visual uses Globe or Icon Cloud component to signify nationwide coverage.

Clean exact copy: 'Transaction Fee: 1% on successful prepaid orders and 0.3% on successful COD orders', 'COD Verification: FREE Forever' (highlight FREE in success green #16A34A), 'SMS OTP: ₹0.30/message', 'WhatsApp Utility: Starting at ₹0.40/message', 'Zero Setup Fee, Dedicated 1:1 Support'. Wrap in Neon Gradient Card. CTA is Rainbow Button.
Dark inverted band or highly contrasting section. Display 3 key stats using Number Ticker. E.g., '<NumberTicker value={100} />M+ Orders Processed', '<NumberTicker value={99.9} />% Uptime'.
2 rows of Marquee moving in opposite directions. Each testimonial wrapped in a Magic Card with a subtle border. Incorporate the portrait images provided in media URLs.
Terminal component showing a mock install command (e.g., 'npm install @rabbitpay/shopify') and a Script Copy Button interaction. Left side explains how easy it is to integrate (literally copy-paste).
Center aligned. Headline: 'Ready to increase your conversions?'. Use Warp Background or Particles effect behind the text. Massive Shimmer button CTA 'Get Started'.
Multi-column footer. Top border. Subtle Dot Pattern background at opacity-20. Columns for Product, Company, Legal. Copyright text.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The site MUST BE FULLY RESPONSIVE (mobile-first). Avoid fixed heights that break on mobile.
Do NOT use badges, pill labels, or 'shiny text' chips above headings. Use strong typographic hierarchy instead.
For the iPhone mockup in the hero, build a CSS-only device frame with a rounded white container containing a mock checkout summary (Pay ₹1,200, Pay via UPI button, etc).
All Magic UI components MUST be properly installed and imported according to their React/Tailwind documentation.
For the Marquee Logo Wall, just use typed-out SVG text logos or stylised text for 'Qwerty Cases', 'Rabbit Rain', 'Perlex', 'Airy Store' since we do not have their explicit SVGs.
Include 'data-testid' on every interactive element (links, buttons, form controls).
Ensure dark mode logic uses 'dark:' variants extensively to respect the user's toggle.
Use framer-motion heavily as Magic UI relies on it. Install 'framer-motion', 'clsx', 'tailwind-merge', and 'lucide-react'.
